以下是团队已确认的产品约束，不是官方对所有参赛作品的要求。基于项目手册v3.6和2026-10-18用户确认的范围更新；协议细节仍为待验证草案，现有构建、NSH协议和已运行固件的能力须与新增目标分别说明。 | 编号 | 必须遵守的要求 | |---|---| | V1 | VelaGuard 是 STM32H750B-DK 上的独立网关，不依赖长期连接电脑。USB CDC/UART 用于开发调试、配置和救援，不作为正式运行依赖。 | | V2 | 本地确定性流程必须离线运行：Modbus采集、帧统计、规则告警、LED与屏幕显示、配置和事件日志、数字量输出安全默认态。网络、MQTT、MiMo、设备端Agent、OTA、电脑或手机不可用时，这些功能仍继续。联网AI失败时展示本地规则和真实数据，不伪造解释或报告。已授权的手机语音巡检由手机录音/播放、云侧ASR/TTS及板载Agent只读查询组成，待实现；不扩展板端音频驱动、本地音频告警或离线ASR/TTS。 | | V3 | 板载 openvela `ai_agent` 使用 ReAct、自定义只读 C 工具及 `/data/agent/skills/` 下的 Markdown Skills，定位为告警解释、日报/周报和自然语言查数的运营助手；不做总线排障、寄存器写入或探测实验。 | | V4 | 运营LLM链路为板端经 `ai_agent` / `llm_proxy`、OpenAI兼容HTTPS直连MiMo。密钥通过 `vgprovision` 加密存于eMMC，不得写进固件镜像。现有MQTT上报遥测、告警、状态和已确认点表；目标OTA经MQTTS传递通知与状态，固件走HTTPS。用户已选择新增MQTT候选配置通道，按ADR 主接入目标为手机同次上传PDF手册和从机地址，云侧AI只生成带原文依据的候选点表，经专用MQTT通道交给板端确定性校验，不试读，人工二次确认后直接添加。远程配置进度、等待和结果只在手机显示；板端仅在手机下发且配置校验通过后弹出二次确认，未确认不生效。新增能力待实现，既有NSH流程继续有效。添加成功仅表示配置生效，实际读数和在线状态由生效后的正常采集确定。总线探查退为维护工具，`vgdiscover`固定9600，LVGL扫描默认关闭，显式开启后才扫描；设备端Agent不参与扫描，不增加波特率矩阵。 | | V7 | 已确认的OTA目标为MQTTS传递升级通知、接受状态、进度和结果，板端通过HTTPS流式下载固件到eMMC，校验摘要、签名、型号/版本后，由片内boot stub在重启阶段烧写QSPI，验证新固件并支持失败恢复。OTA暂存使用现有eMMC FAT的`/mnt/emmc/VGOTA/`，不重新格式化；每个新版本安装前必须由用户在本机屏幕或按键明确确认，MQTT、手机、语音识别结果和设备端Agent不能确认安装；回滚目标为出厂A槽；OTA仅使用RJ45出口。QSPI XIP运行期间不能擦写正在执行的QSPI。MQTT固件分片传输方案已被替代，见 [ADR 0006](docs/adr/0006-mqtts-control-https-download-ota.md)，实现细节见 [ADR 0008](docs/adr/0008-ota-fat-staging-with-local-confirmation.md)；当前MQTTS、HTTPS下载器和完整升级/回滚仍待实现，不得把现有明文MQTT或启动stub当作已完成OTA。 | | V8 | | 涉及真实开发板电路的驱动、pinmux、外设 bring-up、扩展板接线或任何 MCU 引脚/网络判断，必须先按下方硬件资料要求核对。纯应用逻辑、MQTT、提示词或文档整理不要求打开硬件资料包。 | ### 人工确认与设备端工具 - 上位机通过 **ST-LINK 虚拟串口 -> 板端 NSH** 修改候选点表；`add` / `set` / `del` 和 `test` 不得改变已确认表。周期采集、首页和告警只使用已确认表。 - `vgpoint test` 后必须展示结果并**停下来等人确认**，再单独发送 `vgpoint apply --confirm`。当前允许人在 PC 提示处回车或亲自在 NSH 输入确认命令，由板端执行生效；本期不要求屏幕长按确认。不得自动代答确认，也不得把编辑、试读和 apply 合成一条命令；固件不得在试读成功后自动 apply。 - 上述试读步骤适用于现行NSH。新增手机入口按用户更正采用候选下发、确定性校验、板端人工二次确认、直接添加，不做试读；新接口交付前仍按现有NSH协议验收。云侧解析完成、手机上传、ASR文本或设备端Agent调用不能替代人工确认。 - MQTT候选通道的设计见 [ADR 0007](docs/adr/0007-mqtt-candidate-import-with-local-confirmation.md) 与 [协议草案](docs/velaguard-candidate-mqtt-protocol.md)。远程候选不得被原NSH apply读取；实施时同步增加配置入口互斥、候选版本与本地确认绑定，不提供MQTT test/apply/confirm。当前固件尚未实现这些检查，不能只放开订阅就宣称完成接入。 - 设备端 Agent 禁止调用 `vgpoint` 的全部子命令，包括 `get`，以及 `vgdiscover apply`、`vgcfg commit`。开发助手进行获准的调试也必须遵守上面的人工确认步骤。 - 只读权限、参数上限、限流、会话门控和工具调用审计必须落实在工具注册与 C 实现中，不能只依赖提示词。`tool_guard.c` 不提供 JSON Schema 参数运行时校验，自定义工具必须检查越界参数。 - RS485只由板端作为Modbus主站使用，同一总线不得同时存在第二个主站。不经RS485或第二路UART下发点表配置；MQTT仅允许上述专用候选通道，不能远程使配置生效；主机模拟从站时关闭其主站采集会话。 - 完整 API key、MQTT token、产品密钥和 OTA 私钥不得出现在 UI、日志、串口输出或 MQTT payload 中。命令和数据格式继续以 [NSH 协议](docs/velaguard-host-nsh-protocol.md) 为准，不在各任务重复维护命令表。 ### 硬件资料要求 - Windows 官方资料包：`F:\Project\Embeded\H750B-DK\BOARD INFO\H750B-DK`。 - WSL 对应路径：`/mnt/f/Project/Embeded/H750B-DK/BOARD INFO/H750B-DK`。 - 资料优先级：**原理图 PDF / SchDoc > `bsp/` 中 ST BSP > ST UM / data brief**。 - 文件名含 `unofficial` 的资料只能辅助检索，编码前必须用原理图或 BSP 交叉核对。资料包可用时，不得仅凭网上 UM 摘录或第三方 pinmux 笔记作结论；无法访问必要资料时先说明缺少的证据，不猜引脚。 ## 开发与日志操作 以下是团队操作约定，只约束开发流程，不修改竞赛或产品安全要求。 1. 先确认当前 git 状态、任务目标和改动所属仓库，保留用户及其他任务的未提交改动。按当前任务读取相关手册和 ADR，不要求每次读取全部专项文档。 2. 日常固件入口是在**本仓根目录**运行 `bash scripts/build.sh`，默认 `velaguard-lvgl`；不把父目录通用 `./build.sh` 当作日常入口。该脚本使用父级完整 openvela 工作区。 3. 构建脚本只验证公共树已具备所需 VelaGuard 改动，不应用竞赛仓补丁。将 `scripts/configs/*.defconfig` 安装到 NuttX 板级配置属于允许的配置复制。 4. 产品协议或点表逻辑改动按范围执行 `make -C app/velaguard/host_tests test`，板端改动按相应 skill 验收。文档修改不要求编译烧录；不得将未执行的测试、推测或历史验收写成当前成功证据。 | 公共源码树 | 常见功能分支 | 改动归属 | |---|---|---| | `../nuttx` | `velaguard/*` | 板级引脚、驱动、defconfig、LTDC/FT5x06 | | `../apps` | `velaguard/netinit-esp8266` | netinit / ESP8266 兼容 | | MQTT-C 的实际 checkout | `velaguard/mqtt-pal-hook` | PAL send/recv hooks | | `../packages` 下对应实际 checkout | `velaguard/*` | `ai_agent` 等框架修复，含 HMI 内存安全 | ### AI Coding 日志 - 采集范围通过向上查找 `.repo/` 确定。工作区内日志可能在会话结束后自动入仓，staging 不应视为隐私隔离区；工作区外不采集。自动入仓与上传 GitHub 是两个步骤。 - 当前机器身份记录为 `~/.claude/contest-collector.env`，`TEAM_ID=contest2026_004_TeamFalcons`、`GITHUB_LOGIN=Foleaf`。其他成员必须使用自己的报名 GitHub 账号，不能照抄 Foleaf。 - 新环境需要安装时，在本仓运行 `bash ../.claude/skills/contest-log-collector/onboarding/install.sh --team-id contest2026_004_TeamFalcons --github-login <本人的GitHub账号>`。 - 健康检查：`bash ../.claude/skills/contest-log-collector/onboarding/verify-setup.sh`。会话清单：`contest-snapshot --list`。发现日志缺失时先查工作区和采集配置，不自行编造或改写日志补齐。 - 提交前官方日志校验命令：`python3 ../.claude/skills/contest-log-collector/tools/validate-log.py logs/`。校验通过不代表已满足全部竞赛要求，也不代表日志已推送。 - 日志经人工检查后可与代码一起 commit/push；采集器不自动推送。不得因本地存在日志而宣称已完成竞赛提交。 ## 参赛证据与提交检查 这是待逐项验证的清单，不是已完成状态： - 产品源码及 /****************************************************************************
 * arch/arm/src/armv7-m/vg_diag.h
 *
 * Temporary QA-04 diagnostic counters (VelaGuard maintenance branch).
 *
 * Purpose: when the system freezes (g_system_ticks stops while SYST_CVR
 * keeps running), decide from one read-only snapshot which interrupt paths
 * are still being entered and left, whether SysTick is entered at all, and
 * whether a normal thread still makes progress.
 *
 * Rules for every site in here:
 *   - interrupt context only does a 32-bit increment and, at some entry
 *     points, a register read; no printing, no waiting, no allocation and
 *     no locks;
 *   - all state is plain RAM, meant to be read later with a debugger;
 *   - counters are free-running and never cleared, so a snapshot taken
 *     before the run can be subtracted from the snapshot taken at the
 *     freeze.
 *
 * Every counter is a separate global symbol on purpose: the release build
 * carries no DWARF for kernel objects, and a debugger can still read a
 * symbol by name.
 *
 * Entry and exit counters are independent.  A difference between them only
 * means a call was still in progress at the instant of the snapshot; it is
 * not by itself evidence of a stuck handler.  Judge that together with the
 * halted PC, the interrupted PC recorded at the last PendSV, and the other
 * counters.
 ****************************************************************************/

## Summary

VelaGuard 在 STM32H750B-DK 上的固件主线：本 PR 是 `velaguard/ota-h750-rng` 分支相对 `dev-ai-contest-2026` 的全部改动，39 个提交、55 个文件、+7520/-172。

```text
arch/arm/src/stm32h7
├── RNG            H750 硬件随机源，mbedTLS 播种
├── SAI/PDM        PDM 采集、WM8994 播放、DMA 生命周期
├── eth            MII PHY 轮询、PHY ioctl 与网络锁串行化
└── ltdc           LTDC 错误不再完成帧交换

boards/arm/stm32h7/stm32h750b-dk
├── velaguard-lvgl defconfig   与参赛仓 scripts/configs 完全一致
├── USER1 按键、QSPI XIP 启动、RS485 DIR 时序
└── SDRAM 布局与堆区调整

mmcsd / qspi     CSD 经 MMC_IOC_CMD 暴露；XIP 窗口 64 MiB、槽位标记
net/tcp, netdb   POLLOUT 只对已连接套接字；DNS 查询带预算并可回收
```

三类关键改动：

1. OTA 前置能力。片内 boot stub 需要确认槽位与 XIP 映射，本 PR 暴露 QSPI 槽位标记和链接基址，把 XIP 窗口按实际容量落到 64 MiB，并通过 `MMC_IOC_CMD` 读取 eMMC CSD，供升级判断容量。
2. 熵源。H750 片内 RNG 接上 mbedTLS 播种，替代此前依赖外部数据的路径；PHY ioctl 与网络锁改为串行，避免并发下互相等待。
3. 板级配置归位。`velaguard-lvgl` defconfig 与参赛仓发布用的 `scripts/configs/velaguard-lvgl.defconfig` 逐字一致，移除了临时的 `CONFIG_DEBUG_FREEZE_DIAG` 诊断，Wi-Fi 与 MQTT 凭据一律留空，真实值只存在本地构建配置与板端密封记录中。

## Evidence

- **Before:** 板级 defconfig 仍带 QA-04 临时冻结诊断开关，凭据写死在配置里，XIP 窗口小于器件实际容量。
  **After:** 该分支构建出的镜像即参赛仓发布配置；板端运行记录（OTA 就绪探针、QSPI 读写、语音与网络验收）按日期记录在参赛仓 `docs/` 的 OTA 与板级证据文档中，本 PR 未重新执行这些板测。

- `arch/arm/src/armv7-m/vg_diag.h` 是 QA-04 诊断遗留文件，未被任何代码引用，未包含在本 PR 中。

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

改动集中在 STM32H750B-DK 板级与 stm32h7 架构目录，回退即恢复旧配置；不改变其他板卡的默认配置。

**Blast Radius:** board-scoped，外带三处核心修正

`net/tcp` 的 POLLOUT 判定、`mm` 的 `mm_foreach` 编译条件、`netdb` 的 DNS 预算属于核心路径，但都收窄了原有行为，未引入新的默认值。
EOF

## Summary

VelaGuard 板载 `ai_agent` 的主线改动，52 个提交、78 个文件、+10595/-674，覆盖四件事：

```text
src/transport (TLS/HTTP)
├── 大请求体分段上传，超时与取消贯通一次请求
├── 语音独占 keep-alive 连接槽，POLLOUT 后确认握手已建立
└── 响应体按 RFC 9112 判定结束，非 200 与截断带诊断

src/tools
├── 只读工具面收窄，VelaGuard 内建工具按白名单注册
├── 参数越界在 C 层拒绝，审计批量落盘且脱敏
└── 单点查数命中后直接展示，省掉第二次模型往返

src/agent
├── 提示词正文缓存，连接断开快速失败
├── 调用方可以放弃一轮等待
└── /\data 退化为 tmpfs 时升 ERR 告警

HMI / 板端
├── SRAM 紧张模式与心跳保活
└── 本地时区偏移可配置
```

主要意图：

1. 语音链路可用。ASR/TTS 走独立的 TLS 连接槽，前台请求有截止时间且可取消；旧实现里语音请求与后台请求互相拖住，或在大请求体上写入不完整。
2. 只读边界落在 C 实现里。工具注册与参数检查不依赖提示词，禁止文件写入跟随末段软链接，`date` 等只读参数完整匹配，限流额度原子预留。
3. 可观测。请求分段计时、首行 SSE 观测、TLS 握手取证静态池，用于定位 -0x4380 与等待时间来源。

## Evidence

- **Before:** 大请求体 TLS 写入会截断，语音请求与后台请求共用连接槽，工具参数只靠提示词约束。

新增能力集中在本包内，回退到旧行为不需要迁移用户数据。

**Blast Radius:** 本包全部消费者

EOF

=== ff29d9b1a586
fix(stm32h7): 在 TX 完成中断里释放 RS485 DIR

D-04 根因：DIR 只在 up_txempty() 里切回接收，而 up_txempty() 由
tcdrain() 的等待循环调用，那个循环用 nxsig_usleep(POLL_DELAY_USEC)，
POLL_DELAY_USEC 是 1000us 但 nxsig_usleep 会向上取整到系统 tick，
本板 CONFIG_USEC_PER_TICK=10000。板端用 DWT 周期计数器实测，一次轮询
间隔是 12.7-13.8ms，不是 1ms，所以 TC 置位后 DIR 最多要等约 13ms 才
释放；从站在这个窗口内回复时整帧被丢掉。

实测同时确认 up_udelay(400) 本身是准的（354-420us），问题在轮询粒度。

改动：

  - TX 完成中断里直接写 DIR 为接收，与上游 NuttX 的 STM32 驱动一致，
    也等同 STM32 硬件自己的 DE 输出在 DEDT = 0 时的行为；
  - up_txempty() 改回纯查询语义（TXE|TC 都置位才算空闲），保留一次
    DIR 写入作为兜底，覆盖从未使能 TCIE 的发送路径；
  - 删掉 up_txempty() 里 400us 的忙等。它只把总线悬空推迟 400us，
    并不能消除悬空，放在接收路径上反而带来这次丢帧。

板端复验（43702275f28，18:41:50 构建）：从站回复延迟 0 ms 由修复前的
14%/67% 成功变为 649/649，5 ms 525/525，20 ms 471/471，150 ms 454/454，
四组 boot_timeout=boot_crc=boot_echo=boot_other=0，14 个点位全部在线。

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>

===== 8aa325c6d78f
config(velaguard): sync console stack size to board defconfig

The contest repo adds CONFIG_VG_NSH_STACKSIZE (default 8192) to give the NSH
console thread an explicit larger stack. The previous pthread default of 2048
bytes is insufficient on the vfat rename path: the overflow corrupts the
tls_info_s that NuttX places at the bottom of the stack, and the subsequent
getpid() dereferences a bad pointer, causing a HardFault. Board measurement
shows this path needs 2048 bytes while only 2024 bytes were available.

This is a configuration copy, kept in sync with
scripts/configs/velaguard-lvgl.defconfig in the contest repo.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>

===== 104c74e413f1
fix(stm32h7): use sealed MQTT credentials in board configuration

Remove the compile-time MQTT username and password from the velaguard-lvgl
board defconfig and enable CONFIG_VG_MQTT_CREDENTIALS. The configuration file

===== 73fa2ab489b
fix(stm32h7): release RS485 DIR in the TX complete interrupt

D-04 root cause: DIR was only switched back to receive in up_txempty(), and
up_txempty() is called from the tcdrain() wait loop. That loop uses
nxsig_usleep(POLL_DELAY_USEC) with POLL_DELAY_USEC = 1000 us, but nxsig_usleep
rounds up to the system tick, and this board uses CONFIG_USEC_PER_TICK = 10000.
A DWT cycle counter measurement on the board shows one poll interval takes
12.7-13.8 ms, not 1 ms. After TC is set, DIR can wait up to about 13 ms before
release; a slave replying inside that window loses the whole frame.

The same measurement confirms up_udelay(400) itself is accurate (354-420 us);
the problem is the polling granularity.

Changes:

- Write DIR back to receive directly in the TX complete interrupt, matching
  the upstream NuttX STM32 driver and the STM32 hardware DE output behavior
  with DEDT = 0.
- Restore up_txempty() to a pure query semantic (idle only when both TXE and
  TC are set), keeping one DIR write as a fallback for transmit paths that
  never enabled TCIE.
- Remove the 400 us busy wait from up_txempty(). It only delayed the floating
  bus by 400 us without eliminating it, and on the receive path it caused this
  frame loss.

Board revalidation (build 43702275f28, 18:41:50): slave reply delay 0 ms went
from 14%/67% success before the fix to 649/649; 5 ms 525/525; 20 ms 471/471;
150 ms 454/454. All four groups report boot_timeout=boot_crc=boot_echo=
boot_other=0, and all 14 points are online.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>

"""Rewrite selected commit messages to English for the openvela checkpatch gate."""

import os
import sys

MAP = {
    "29c221670d39cf223f028fc29d8c73948b93741c": """config(velaguard): raise ai_agent stack to 32K

Tool calls and longer HTTPS replies need a larger default stack; align with
scripts/configs in the contest repo.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
""",
    "581e576b65ab1c702f9a2b329cfa1cf42f2d9ba5": """config(velaguard): sync default MQTT broker to board defconfig

Keep aligned with scripts/configs/velaguard-lvgl.defconfig in the contest
repo so the setting is not missed when only the script configuration is
installed.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
""",
    "43702275f28a6acabbbe7deca6ad068524de5148": """config(velaguard): sync console stack size to board defconfig

The contest repo adds CONFIG_VG_NSH_STACKSIZE (default 8192) to give the NSH
console thread an explicit larger stack. The previous pthread default of 2048
bytes is insufficient on the vfat rename path: the overflow corrupts the
tls_info_s that NuttX places at the bottom of the stack, and the subsequent
getpid() dereferences a bad pointer, causing a HardFault. Board measurement
shows this path needs 2048 bytes while only 2024 bytes were available.

This is a configuration copy, kept in sync with
scripts/configs/velaguard-lvgl.defconfig in the contest repo.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>
""",
    "ff29d9b1a586a66642d7f1ac6d1880b78e794f29": """fix(stm32h7): release RS485 DIR in the TX complete interrupt

D-04 root cause: DIR was only switched back to receive in up_txempty(), and
up_txempty() is called from the tcdrain() wait loop. That loop uses
nxsig_usleep(POLL_DELAY_USEC) with POLL_DELAY_USEC = 1000 us, but nxsig_usleep
rounds up to the system tick, and this board uses CONFIG_USEC_PER_TICK = 10000.
A DWT cycle counter measurement on the board shows one poll interval takes
12.7-13.8 ms, not 1 ms. After TC is set, DIR can wait up to about 13 ms before
release; a slave replying inside that window loses the whole frame.

The same measurement confirms up_udelay(400) itself is accurate (354-420 us);
the problem is the polling granularity.

Changes:

- Write DIR back to receive directly in the TX complete interrupt, matching
  the upstream NuttX STM32 driver and the STM32 hardware DE output behavior
  with DEDT = 0.
- Restore up_txempty() to a pure query semantic (idle only when both TXE and
  TC are set), keeping one DIR write as a fallback for transmit paths that
  never enabled TCIE.
- Remove the 400 us busy wait from up_txempty(). It only delayed the floating
  bus by 400 us without eliminating it, and on the receive path it caused this
  frame loss.

Board revalidation (build 43702275f28, 18:41:50): slave reply delay 0 ms went
from 14%/67% success before the fix to 649/649; 5 ms 525/525; 20 ms 471/471;
150 ms 454/454. All four groups report boot_timeout=boot_crc=boot_echo=
boot_other=0, and all 14 points are online.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>
""",
    "2373ab4a45ddfebe67706110db460b27f3a8d127": """fix(stm32h7): use sealed MQTT credentials in board configuration

Remove the compile-time MQTT username and password from the velaguard-lvgl
board defconfig and enable CONFIG_VG_MQTT_CREDENTIALS. The configuration file
is still installed from scripts/configs in the contest repo; runtime
credentials are written to the sealed eMMC record by vgprovision mqtt. The
WiFi static password remains a separate TODO and its configuration
architecture is unchanged in this commit.
""",
    "1b5e71d2f8732e4e3338fc4252167a0fe4adb9b1": """diag(stm32h7): add freeze diagnostic counters (QA-04, temporary)

Read-only counters that tell, after a freeze, which contexts are still
running. They do not change interrupt priorities, masking rules or scheduling
behavior. Controlled by CONFIG_DEBUG_FREEZE_DIAG and disabled by default.

- SysTick: entry and exit counts in stm32_timerisr(), plus g_system_ticks at
  exit.
- PendSV: entry and exit counts for the PendSV branch of arm_doirq(), with the
  BASEPRI, PRIMASK, IPSR and frame xPSR taken at entry, xcp.regs and
  saved_regs; also records whether up_schedule_sigaction() was reached and
  whether the context entered with an empty register set.
- USART2: entry and exit counts in up_interrupt(), counts around
  uart_recvchars(), and the ISR, priv->ie and RX FIFO level at entry.
- Counters live in g_arm_freeze_diag in .bss so a debugger can read them.

Interrupt context only performs one load, one increment and one store: no
printing, no waiting, no allocation and no locking. The board velaguard-lvgl
defconfig enables the option; it is removed after the investigation.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>
""",
}

original = sys.stdin.read()
message = MAP.get(os.environ.get("GIT_COMMIT", ""))
sys.stdout.write(message if message is not None else original)

fix(ai_agent): large TLS request writes, duplicate tool finalization and the read-only boundary

Problems found and fixed during board integration; all of them were hit in
real product use:

1. vela_tls: tls_ctx_connect() left the socket in blocking mode, so
   mbedTLS's net_would_block() never reported WOULD BLOCK and EAGAIN on a
   full send buffer turned into MBEDTLS_ERR_NET_SEND_FAILED.  An LLM request
   body of about 16 KB always failed to write (small requests were fine).
   The new tls_ssl_write_all() caps each write at 4 KB and retries short
   writes and failures with a 20 ms backoff, up to 64 times, logging the
   mbedTLS code and errno.

2. agent_loop: check_tool_dup() simply broke on the fifth call of the same
   tool, with neither a closing reply nor the iteration limit reached, so
   the whole round ended in AGENT_TRACE_FAIL and every earlier tool result
   was discarded.  It now finishes the same way the iteration limit does:
   one force_finish_reply() call concludes from the tool results already
   collected.

3. tool_shell: the subcommand gate now covers more than vgcfg and is
   table-driven.  vgstats and vgruntime allow only dump, vgnet allows only
   status, vgcfg allows only dump.  The old code allowed
   vgstats/vgruntime/vgnet wholesale, yet vgstats inject|reset and
   vgnet inject|wifi change board state and vgruntime report <path> can
   write a file at any path.

   firmware's offline fallback output, so the read-only constraint belongs
   in C, not only in the prompt.

   /data/velaguard/logs/agent_tools.log (monotonic timestamp, tool name,
   redacted argument prefix, result status), rotated at 64 KB; a failed

- chunked: stop at the zero-length chunk
- Content-Length: stop after the declared bytes
- neither: stop when the peer closes

  point_shortcut on, and resets on reboot.

  user message and the cache replayed one arm's answer to the other; the hit
  round did not call the model at all, so both arms showed zero requests and
  nothing was measured.  cache_clear lets the measurement script clear it
  before each round.
- Let the question decide whether to yield.  A question that asks why the UPS
  load is high also resolves to a point, but it asks for a reason, and
  answering with a reading is not an answer.  Words for explanation,
  judgement, comparison, trend, alarm and report, and questions naming several
  points, always go back to the full flow.
- Stale samples are no longer answered directly, and direct answers are no
  longer written to the reply cache.  The cache TTL is 300 s while sample age
  is in seconds, so a replay would present an old value as current.

incomplete / read_failed / no_sample / stale / not_direct / render_error),
because otherwise a correct yield and a shortcut that never fired look the
same and the hit rate cannot be counted.

Board data: hit rounds use exactly 1 request against 2-4 on the off arm; the
median round went 10.68 s -> 5.82 s, with a per-pair median difference of
6.83 s and 10 of 11 pairs faster; all 11 hit rounds matched the slave set
values in point name, value, unit, sample time and online state; the eight

assumptions were fixed, each of which would answer wrongly once an upstream
